span.p:
contacts/nt SATURATES at 4.4-4.9
=> contacts scale O(L), NOT O(L^2)

span.p:
dense pair track at L=2048 = 309 GB activations
= not viable on any hardware

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 1 - PROPOSAL O(L*w)
low-rank outer product + Turner
nearest-neighbour prior
no L x L tensor materialised

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 2 - SELECT K = c*L, c=32
need 4.40 median, 5.42 p95, 5.50 max
=> 6x headroom
L=2048: 65536 edges = 1.56 pct dense
16.8 MB not 1.07 GB

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 3 - SPARSE TRIANGLE UPDATES
triangle inequality enforced on
induced K-edge subgraph only

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 4 - RE-SELECT EACH RECYCLE
top-K is a soft revisable commitment,
not a hard early prune

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FAILURE MODE
a contact never proposed can never be predicted.
Mitigations: 6x headroom, per-recycle re-selection,
recall-oriented auxiliary loss on the proposal stage.
PROPOSAL RECALL MUST BE REPORTED PER LENGTH BIN -
silently dropping 5 pct of contacts would be an
invisible accuracy ceiling.
